name: Arcie Fidel
source: Arcie resembles the girl from high society, but she hides her origin for some reason, and even stammers while trying to tell her own name. As if lost, she gave the impression of a person who knows almost nothing about the life of ordinary people. Naivety of Arcie could cost her her life, if Caro wouldn't saved her from the street criminals. He kindly agreed to show her various interesting places in the celebrating town. Thus begins their joint odyssey in which Arcie will show her courage, will protect the justice, and will share her sincere heat with the people around.
